summary: Provide OpenID Connect sign-in for self-hosted applications using passkeys, with users and access managed from a web interface.
overview: Pocket ID gives compatible applications a shared identity provider, so each service can delegate sign-in through OpenID Connect. Passkeys handle authentication, while its administration interface manages the users. It is useful when several self-hosted services support OIDC and you want their sign-in flow to draw on the same user directory rather than configuring accounts independently everywhere.
